title: Judge Gift Cards 2016: card flavor text

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Speaker of flavor text on Mana Drain, who holds that power is wasted on the weak.

entities.name: Azusa, Lost but Seeking
entities.description: A wanderer who considers all of Kamigawa her home and its people her family.

entities.name: Jukai Forest
entities.description: A forest on Kamigawa that Azusa says is not her home.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane Azusa calls her home.

entities.name: Riku of Two Reflections
entities.description: A speaker who once gazed into a light that now burns in his mind, denying him rest.

entities.name: Zur the Enchanter
entities.description: An enchanter who remained aloof from Terisiare's suffering, intent on his own perfection.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: A land whose suffering Zur ignored.

events.summary: Riku of Two Reflections gazed into a light that now burns in his mind, forever denying him rest (recounted as a memory).
events.quote: I gazed once into that light. Now it burns in my mind, forever denying me rest.

events.summary: Zur stays aloof from Terisiare's suffering, focused on his own perfection.
events.quote: Zur remained aloof from Terisiare's suffering, intent only on his own perfection.

relations.quote: My home is Kamigawa, its people my family.

relations.note: Implied by Azusa's contrast; forest on Kamigawa
relations.quote: I do not miss Jukai Forest. It is not my home. My home is Kamigawa
Zur remained aloof from Terisiare's suffering
